# [diagnostics] Fuse and relay maps

> **Some safety-critical values on this page are not confirmed** (marked [Unverified] or [Partial]): they come from one source or are only partly supported. Verify against the factory service manual before use; later runs re-check them against new sources.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Locate the IPDM fuse box and match the physical fuse number to identify specific circuit assignments. [t17]

[Partial] Run a large positive wire from the battery to the fuse block and route a separate negative ground back. [t383]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Run a large positive wire from the battery to the fuse block.
2. [Partial] Route a separate negative ground wire back to the battery or chassis.

_Procedure reported by [t383]._

<details><summary>Alternate procedure [t17] [Partial]</summary>

1. Swap the IPDM unit from a donor vehicle to test compatibility.

</details>

## Specifications

- **Fuse block capacity**: 100A [t383] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Fuse Number**: 1-53+ [t17] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)
- **Wire gauge for main run**: 4awg [t383] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Follow an 80% rule for wire sizing so nominal loads are only 80% of the current rating to prevent heat. [t383]
- Upsize wires if running long distances or high currents. [t383]
